item.title: National intelligence chief to lead US artificial intelligence task force
item.description:
US President Donald Trump and Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton following a meeting with tech executives on artificial intelligence at the White House in Washington, DC, US, on Tuesday, Sept.
#### The Brief - President Donald Trump selected Director of National Intelligence Jay Clayton to lead a new artificial intelligence task force. - The task force is designed to coordinate the federal government’s effort to promote artificial intelligence.
The man in charge of national intelligence for the United States is now the point person on a new task force for artificial intelligence.
The task force is designed to coordinate the federal government’s effort "to ensure that America continues to lead the World in Super Intelligence, which many say is bigger than the Industrial Revolution, and the Internet, and will protect the interests, and improve the lives, of all Americans," Trump wrote in a post on social media Sunday, using his preferred term for artificial intelligence.
